entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: A disgraced Malakir vampire sage of House Ghet who joins Tarsa's party to study the Ondu Skyclave, hoping for knowledge and redemption.

entities.name: Tarsa
entities.description: The swordsman leader of a brutal, coin-focused expedition party in Nimana.

entities.name: Nadino
entities.description: A kor wizard of Tarsa's party who casts fire and ice and is grieving a lost partner.

entities.name: Eret
entities.description: An elven cleric of Tarsa's party who distrusts Anowon.

entities.name: Orien
entities.description: A former member of Tarsa's party killed by Grakmaw in Ondu.

entities.name: Emissary
entities.description: An unnamed envoy who hires Tarsa's party on behalf of a secret client to kill Grakmaw.

entities.name: Tenihas
entities.description: A vampire of House Ghet who took in Anowon and taught him to value histories.

entities.name: Jolly
entities.description: Nadino's gnarlid companion.

entities.name: Grakmaw
entities.description: A giant multi-headed hydra haunting the Ondu Skyclave, possibly created by kor experiments, killed when Anowon petrifies it.

entities.name: Faduun
entities.description: Stone faces with glowing jaws on Jwar Isle that seem to whisper in an unknown tongue.

entities.name: Tarsa's party
entities.description: A mercenary expedition crew from Nimana of Tarsa, Nadino, Eret and the lost Orien.

entities.name: House Ghet
entities.description: The vampire house that took Anowon in.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The beings that sought to corrupt vampire bloodchiefs and clans.

entities.name: Ancient kor
entities.description: The builders of the Skyclaves who experimented on beasts.

entities.name: Nimana
entities.description: The free city where Tarsa's party seeks work.

entities.name: Jwar Isle
entities.description: An island holding the Ondu Skyclave.

entities.name: Ondu Skyclave
entities.description: An ancient kor weapons laboratory with a proving room and tessellated walls that function as text and map.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: The region where Tarsa's party operates.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: The Zendikari continent where Orien was lost.

entities.name: Makindi
entities.description: The ancient kor capital buried when its Skyclave fell.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city where Anowon once studied.

entities.name: Serpent's Maw
entities.description: The stormy waters crossed to reach Jwar Isle.

entities.name: Cloudy yellow potion
entities.description: A kor potion that turns Grakmaw's heads to stone.

events.summary: An emissary seeks out Tarsa in Nimana's market, while the vampire Anowon secretly follows.
events.quote: Neither had noticed the vampire behind them

events.summary: The emissary offers Tarsa's party a job in Ondu, killing the hydra Grakmaw in the Jwar Isle Skyclave, for a per-head payment.
Eret seizes Anowon as a spy, and Anowon asks to join the party for a fraction of the earnings in exchange for knowledge.
events.quote: I offer to serve your party for a fraction of your earnings.

events.summary: The party sails to Jwar Isle, tormented by suspicions of Anowon, and hears the faduun.
events.quote: Behind him, he could hear a dark, gravelly voice grumble in a tongue unknown to him.

events.summary: Anowon scouts ahead and climbs the cliffs, then reaches the Skyclave and studies the walls, finding they are also a map.
Grakmaw attacks, but Anowon's idea of becoming cold lets the party hide beneath snow from its heat sense.
events.quote: You all need to become colder!

events.summary: Anowon drinks vials of blood to heal, and Tarsa asks why he really travels with them.
events.quote: What is so important about this to you?

events.summary: Anowon studies the Skyclave and learns the walls describe a weapons facility that rebelled against the kor capital at Makindi.
events.quote: This was the Skyclave that rebelled against the ancient kor capital at Makindi.

events.summary: The party reaches the proving room where Nadino finds remains of Orien's scarf.
events.quote: That damned . . . thing . . . dragged him here . . . tore him up . . .

events.summary: Tarsa objects to Anowon taking kor poisons, and Grakmaw attacks the proving room.
events.quote: Any hands that know how to twist Zendikar are the wrong hands.

events.summary: Anowon throws a kor potion, shattered by Nadino's blade, that turns Grakmaw's heads to stone and kills it.
events.quote: In a matter of seconds, all the beast's heads were sharp, spiked stone

events.summary: Tarsa thanks Anowon and invites him to be their fourth hook; Anowon realizes he longs for belonging.
events.quote: You're free to be our fourth hook whenever you wish.

relations.note: Joins the party for a fraction of earnings and is later welcomed.
relations.quote: You're free to be our fourth hook whenever you wish.

relations.note: Tarsa is the boss of the crew.
relations.quote: Boss!" the elf called out to Tarsa.

relations.note: Anowon belonged to House Ghet, which took him in.
relations.quote: when Tenihas of House Ghet took him in and taught him to value the histories

relations.note: Tenihas took him in and taught him histories.
relations.quote: Tenihas of House Ghet took him in and taught him to value the histories

relations.note: His potion petrifies and kills the hydra.
relations.quote: In a matter of seconds, all the beast's heads were sharp, spiked stone

relations.note: The hydra dragged Orien to the proving room and tore him up.
relations.quote: That damned . . . thing . . . dragged him here . . . tore him up . . .

relations.note: Nadino is a member of Tarsa's crew.
relations.quote: Nadino, get higher ground and keep moving to hit it.
